subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers land, adopt, replace, or reject the open fork PR that applies the sidebar markdown image sizing parity fix?
rationale: The issue has a source-visible narrow fix path and an open closing-syntax PR, but the PR is in a fork with maintainer edits disabled, so automation should not open a competing fix PR without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or replace the fork patch
options.body: Create or reuse a maintainer-controlled branch with the same sidebar CSS parity change and add browser proof if the fork cannot be landed cleanly.

options.title: Review and merge the fork PR
options.body: Accept the open fork PR if maintainers are comfortable with its current branch state, checks, and proof.

options.title: Reject sidebar parity
options.body: Close the issue only if maintainers decide the wider sidebar image behavior is intentional or not worth changing.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the fork patch
recommendation.body: Create or reuse a maintainer-controlled branch with the same sidebar CSS parity change and add browser proof if the fork cannot be landed cleanly.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev carried the merged UI styling change that introduced both the current sidebar rule and the main-chat comparison target.
